{{Top|leg}}
'''Molecular bonding''' was a construction technique which joined materials by rearranging the molecules at the point they converged. The technique resulted in no visible seam, and was a more reliable join than any produced by [[Fusion welder/Legends|fusion]] or [[Sonic welder/Legends|sonic welding]].
